articles.text: SPEAKER A: अन्दर आइये । कुर्सी पर बैठिये ।
SPEAKER A: Come in. Sit on the chair.
SPEAKER B: शुक्रिया ।
SPEAKER B: Thank you.
SPEAKER A: आपका नाम क्या है ?
SPEAKER A: What is your name?
SPEAKER B: मेरा नाम मदन है ।
SPEAKER B: My name is Madan.
SPEAKER A: आपकी किताब कहाँ है ?
SPEAKER A: Where is your book?
SPEAKER B: यहाँ है ।
SPEAKER B: Here it is.
SPEAKER A: अच्छा, आपकी कौनसी है ?
SPEAKER A: Okay, which one is yours?
SPEAKER B: यह मेरी है और वह वह मेरी पत्नी की है ।
SPEAKER B: This one is mine and that one belongs to my wife.
SPEAKER A: आपकी जेब में है ?
SPEAKER A: Is it in your pocket?
SPEAKER B: जी नहीं, मेरी जेब में नहीं, हाथ में है ।
SPEAKER B: No, not in my pocket, it's in my hand.
